MDM.SealVerified: Seal {code} verified: this result was fixed when they went down.
MDM.SealBroken: Seal {code} does not match: this result was changed after sealing.

Window.Title: Death Save: {name}
Window.Sealed: Their fate is sealed. Nobody has seen it.
Window.Hint: The dice have already fallen. Check on them to find out.

Chat.SealedBody: {name} is down. Their Death Save has been rolled and sealed, unseen by anyone.

Verify.Title: Check on them?
Verify.Body: {user} wants to check on {name}. Reveal the sealed Death Save to everyone now?

Discard.Title: Discard sealed Death Save
Discard.Body: Throw away {name}'s sealed Death Save without revealing it? Nobody will ever see the result.

Notify.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to seal or reveal a Death Save.
Notify.AskedGM: Asked the GM to let you check on them.
Notify.Denied: The GM says not yet: {name}'s fate stays sealed.
Notify.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character first.

Error.NoTable: Could not find the Mothership 1e Death Save table. Check the MoSh system's roll table settings.

AutoSeal.Name: Seal automatically at max Wounds
AutoSeal.Hint: Roll and seal a Death Save as soon as a character's Wounds reach their maximum. Turn off to seal only by macro.

GMVerify.Name: GM verify before reveal
GMVerify.Hint: A player's "Check on them" click becomes a request the GM must approve, so an accidental click can't spoil the moment.

ShowDice.Name: Roll Dice So Nice dice on reveal
ShowDice.Hint: When a sealed Death Save is revealed, show the stored roll with Dice So Nice, if it is installed.
